accounts.title: User accounts
accounts.subtitleAdmin: Every account on the platform: super-admins, federation seats and referees.
accounts.subtitleFederation: Your referees' accounts: creation, activation, password and language.
accounts.federationNote: You manage the referee accounts of {country}. The seats of your federation are shown read-only.
accounts.name: Full name
accounts.emptyHint: Create the first account to give someone access to the platform.
accounts.newHint: The holder signs in with their e-mail and the password you set here.

roleHint.admin: Access to every country and to all administration.
roleHint.federation: A seat of one national federation, confined to its country.
roleHint.referee: A referee's personal space: designations, availability, payments.

accounts.deactivateBody: {name} will no longer be able to sign in and is signed out immediately. You can reactivate the account at any time.
accounts.resetHint: Set a new password for {name}. Their open sessions will be closed.
accounts.roleWarning: {from} becomes {to}. Permissions change immediately and the current session is closed: the person must sign in again.

federations.title: National federations
federations.subtitle: One federation per country: its status, logo and access seats.
federations.name: Name
federations.emptyHint: Create a country's federation to open its portal.
federations.noSeatsHint: Add a seat so this federation can sign in.
federations.suspendedSeatsNote: Federation suspended: its seats are closed.
federations.newHint: Only supported countries that have no federation yet are offered.
federations.noFreeCountry: Every active country already has a federation.
federations.agreementHint: Optional. Number or title of the agreement signed with CAF.
federations.suspendBody: {name} ({country}) loses access to its portal while suspended. Its data is kept.
federations.suspendSeats: All of its seats ({count}) are closed at once and their sessions are cut immediately.
federations.reactivateBody: {name} becomes active again. Check that its seats are active before telling the federation.

countries.title: Supported countries
countries.subtitle: The platform's country list, the same as AfriScout's: codes, names, zone, time zone and currency.
countries.newHint: The alpha-3 code identifies the country everywhere in ARIS and cannot be changed afterwards.
countries.codeHint: Three capital letters, for example MAR.
countries.iso2Hint: Two capital letters, for example MA.
countries.federationHint: Fill it in to create the country's federation at the same time; you can also do it later.
countries.deactivateBody: {name} leaves the list of supported countries. Its data is kept and you can reactivate it.
countries.deactivatePortal: The portal of the {federation} federation is closed: all its seats are signed out at once.
countries.deactivateNoPortal: No federation is attached to this country: no portal is closed.

teams.title: Teams and stadiums
teams.subtitleAdmin: Each country's reference data: clubs, national sides and stadiums.
teams.subtitleFederation: The clubs, national sides and stadiums of your country.
teams.lockedCountry: Your federation is confined to its country.
teams.pickCountryHint: No active country is available at the moment.
teams.name: Name
teams.emptyTeamsHint: Add the clubs and the national side so fixtures can be scheduled.
teams.emptyStadiumsHint: Add the stadiums where matches are played.

audit.subtitleAdmin: Every change on the platform, newest first.
audit.subtitleFederation: The changes that concern your country, newest first.
